papers.title: Jev-Mobile: Jev as an Executor for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.summary_en: Uses VLM local-goal planning with Jev action selection over Android accessibility-tree candidates; reported time and API-cost savings are conditional on successful trajectories and the tested controller configurations.
papers.summary_zh: 用 VLM 规划局部目标，再由 Jev 从 Android 无障碍树候选中选动作；报告的时延和 API 成本节省仅针对成功轨迹及所测控制器配置。
limitations_en: AndroidWorld evidence does not establish transfer to web interfaces or isolate a Jev component effect within an otherwise identical delegated controller. Dedicated author release links were not verified in the inspected fixed-v1 pages.
limitations_zh: AndroidWorld 结果不能确立向网页界面的迁移，也未在其他部分完全相同的委派控制器中隔离 Jev 组件的贡献。已查固定 v1 页面未核验到专用作者发布入口。

papers.title: JEV-Star: Fast, Low-Cost StarCraft II Control with Language-Model Planning
papers.summary_en: Combines Jev action selection with persistent language-model planning for StarCraft II; limited full-game evidence and simultaneous interface changes prevent isolating the planning contribution.

limitations_en: Complete-system comparisons and selected game records are not an isolated planning ablation. The already-known code release includes selected comparison materials, not the full original logs; its current expanded experiments do not replace the paper snapshot.

papers.title: Token-Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration via System One-Guided Computational Division of Labor
papers.summary_en: Separates bounded multi-agent coordination from LLM reasoning through a controller–reader loop; reported GPT-4o-token and end-to-end latency reductions concern complete framework comparisons on seven benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh: 通过控制器—读取器循环分离多智能体的有界协调与 LLM 推理；报告的 GPT-4o token 用量和端到端时延下降来自七个基准上的完整框架比较。
limitations_en: The abstract reports framework-level comparisons with AgentVerse, DyLAN and SelfOrg, not an isolated controller-cost result or a universal accuracy guarantee. A dedicated author implementation was not verified in the fixed-v1 material.
limitations_zh: 摘要报告的是与 AgentVerse、DyLAN 和 SelfOrg 的框架级比较，不是独立控制器成本结果或通用准确性保证。已查固定 v1 材料未核验到专用作者实现。

scope_findings: Mobile retains successful-trajectory conditioning for time and API cost; no universal agent efficiency or equal-success claim is introduced.

JEV-Star retains limited full-game evidence and concurrent interface changes. Its known code link promises selected comparison artifacts, not the full original raw logs or an isolated planning ablation.
S1-MAS retains complete-framework comparisons, its named token-accounting scope and seven-benchmark setting; it does not attribute every measured saving to the controller alone.
No unsupported new author-code links are invented for Mobile or S1-MAS. All canonical paper identities and the JEV-Star code are already present.
No source-curation override is necessary; original evidence hashes, retrieval times, versions and abstract-checked grades are preserved.
independent_review.review_scope: Cached fixed-v1 abstracts/visible author lists/citation metadata plus existing targeted workflow and companion-release reviews; no full-paper audit.
